error[L0110]: Landin writes `elsif`, not `elif`, for another condition of an `if`

  |
4 |     elif x == 0 then
  |     ^^^^
  = note: [1810]: an `if` goes on with `elsif condition then` and ends with an optional `else` and `end if`
  = help: write `elsif`
